Stuck? Help yourself
How do I enter a day of trips?

Open Trip Sheet, pick the site and month, type each driver's quantity under the day, then Save Drafts. Rates and amounts apply themselves. Repeat daily; at month end an HR Manager clicks Submit Month (permanent), then Generate Trip Earnings.

Someone took a loan or advance?

On the Payroll Prep Sheet, click + Add loan / advance - employee, principal, agreed installment. Its deduction then appears on the sheet every month automatically, capped at the balance, until it clears. Advances need nothing: last month's list carries forward; just edit the exceptions.

New person joined mid-month?

They appear on the Prep Sheet by themselves (from the joining date). Type their agreed monthly basic - the sheet pays basic x days/22 this month and creates their full salary assignment from the 1st of next month. SSNIT and PAYE follow automatically.

A figure is wrong after locking?

HR Manager: Trip Sheet > Unlock Month - logs return to editable drafts and unsubmitted earning drafts are removed. Correct, Save, Submit again. If earnings were already approved, cancel those under Additional Salary first.

How do I finish the month?

Open Review & Approve: every group must agree with its source and show green. Approve each group, then the Proceed to Payroll Entry button appears. Run Payroll Entry as usual.
